exposure: Pregnant trauma patients with pelvic fracture
outcome: Use of full trauma CT scan
cohort: 48 pregnant trauma patients, median age 30 years, median stage of pregnancy 22 weeks
finding: Adherence to the ATLS protocol in terms of radiographic studies was low in pregnant trauma patients, but no significant injuries were missed.
mod_finding: Pelvic fracture appears to be predictive of obstetric complications like intrauterine death or cesarean section, but a general association between trauma and cesarean section or premature birth was not found.
